template_id.title: Template Id
template_id.description: Identifier of the created template, formatted as 'project:<node_type>/<slug>'.

replaced.title: Replaced
replaced.description: Whether this overwrote a template the project already had, rather than adding a new one. Two names that differ only in punctuation or case share a slug, so this is the authoritative answer.

400.description: Invalid node_type, or node name is required

404.description: Project, workflow, or node not found
